seed.label: Seed

notes: v0.33 fire_stems (docs/fire.md): source 'fluorescent_flicker', rebuilt from stems of a CC0 recording (THIRD_PARTY.md). Tracked harmonics, persistent lines and the band-envelope bed, with the recording's treble matched above 3 kHz. The seed macro (or any variation) plays a fresh take: the recording's own pieces, forward-only, in a new order with 100 ms crossfades, each real crackle riding with its piece.
